exit_criteria.description: Recovered source is committed on the intended private repository baseline.
A clean Python 3.12 checkout installs, tests, and builds reproducibly.
Required CI and independent review controls pass on the protected baseline.
Current files and repository history contain no credential material.
Previously exposed DeepSeek and EigenField credentials are rotated and replacements are stored only in an approved secret store.
Four known integrity defects have regression tests and reviewed fixes.
One ready work item reaches a reviewed pull request through claim, validation, retry/recovery, and evidence capture.
The restricted commit service is the only server-controlled path that changes formal Program state.
A synthetic F0 Crucible completes with independent challenge, deterministic policy, and human-gated commit.
An authorized read-only evidence adapter binds immutable EigenField snapshots and separates predictions from observations.
Synthetic work order, QC/result, learn-back, and successor Conclave flow completes without automatic advancement.
Production acceptance, restore/rollback, soak, and two route dry-run evidence are independently reviewed.

blockers.description: Credentials previously exposed in chat must be revoked, rotated, and installed by an authorized human before live integration.
Private repository visibility, branch protection, required checks, and merge policy require repository-admin verification.
